kyoto_suruga_bar.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: Shizuoka dishes — fried black hanpen, Fujinomiya yakisoba, gyoza, motsu curry skewers, oden with fish cakes — plus pasta (2023–2026 reviews).
kyoto_suruga_bar.vegan_detail: Not vegan: bonito tataki, black hanpen (fish cake), offal skewers, oden in dashi (2024–2025 reviews).
kyoto_suruga_bar.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 18:00–2:00 (L.O. 1:00); bookings after 21:00 by phone only. Reservations taken; parties of three may be seated at the large U-shaped counter. Starter charge 「お通し350円（税込）」 (¥350 incl. tax, Tabelog Japanese original). Cards, Rakuten Edy and Rakuten Pay. 28 seats: a 12-seat counter and two tables of 8; private hire up to 50. Heated tobacco only inside; cigarettes outside. Wheelchair access. English menu; sommelier on staff. Children by arrangement. 1st floor of the パラドール烏丸ビル on Takoyakushi-dori west of Muromachi, 5 min from Karasuma or Shijo.
kyoto_suruga_bar.notes: [Shizuoka izakaya · Takoyakushi near Karasuma, a one-man late counter] A rare taste of Shizuoka in Kyoto: black-broth Shizuoka oden, black hanpen fry, Fujinomiya yakisoba, bonito tataki and Shizuoka sake, served by a Shizuoka-born owner at a big U-shaped counter until 2 am. About ¥3,000–5,000. ¥350 starter.

chef_bio.background: A January 2025 reviewer describes an owner from Shizuoka with a deep love for the region who runs the place alone, so service can be slow when busy; a June 2025 reviewer chatted with him about Shizuoka oden, Fujinomiya yakisoba and Shimizu S-Pulse. Few reviews give detail; the newest (September 2026) praises the oden, sashimi with sweet wasabi and local sake.
chef_bio.specialty: Shizuoka oden; Shizuoka local dishes and sake.

anecdotes.text: January 2025: "This is probably the only place in Kyoto where you can enjoy Shizuoka-style oden… The owner, who is from Shizuoka, truly embodies a love for the region."
October 2024: "Shizuoka Specialty Black Hanpen Fry — Crunchy coating with a touch of sweetness from the black hanpen."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 駿河バル、バル・居酒屋・パスタ、中京区蛸薬師通室町西入姥柳町203 パラドール烏丸ビル1F、阪急烏丸駅・地下鉄四条駅から徒歩5分、毎日18:00〜翌2:00 (L.O.1:00)、21時以降の予約は電話で、予約可、原文で「お通し350円（税込）」、カード・楽天Edy・楽天ペイ可、28席 (カウンター12、8名テーブル2)、貸切50名まで、加熱式たばこのみ (紙巻きは屋外)、車椅子可、英語メニュー、ソムリエあり。口コミ (2023年10月〜2026年9月、英語): 静岡の食材と郷土料理の居酒屋、静岡おでん (黒はんぺん、じゃがいも、れんこん入りの鶏つくね)、静岡のかつおのたたき、黒はんぺんフライ、Shimizuのもつカレー串、Fujinomiyaやきそば、餃子、刺身と甘いわさび、静岡の地酒、静岡出身の店主が一人で営む (2025年1月)。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog); one-person service can be slow; ¥350 starter.

kyoto_nijo_fujita.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: kaiseki courses with fu, soy-based dashi dishes, chirashi sushi and wagashi (2010–2025 reviews).
kyoto_nijo_fujita.vegan_detail: Not vegan: seafood and suppon (soft-shelled turtle) courses (2010–2025 reviews).
kyoto_nijo_fujita.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri, Sat 17:00–21:00; closed Wednesday and Sunday; hours may change. Reservations taken; lunch for groups by reservation (2012–2013 reviews). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners). Counter and a table downstairs, a banquet room upstairs (2016). Non-smoking. On Nijo-dori just east of Teramachi, near Kyoto City Hall.
kyoto_nijo_fujita.notes: [Kyoto kaiseki · Nijo-Teramachi near City Hall, a quiet family counter] A calm, honest kaiseki counter on a quiet stretch of Nijo-dori: suppon soup all year, hamo in summer, steamed sushi in winter, always finishing with chirashi sushi and the owner's family wagashi with matcha. About ¥10,000–15,000. Closed Wednesday and Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers since 2010 describe a friendly owner, his cheerful wife and young staff (2015; 2020); a 2015 reviewer writes that the owner opened here for the good well water and that the wagashi come from his family, a confectioner ("Nijo Wakasa-ya" per 2012 and 2016 reviewers; romaji as given). A July 2020 reviewer mentions a head chef in the back kitchen. Featured on KBS Kyoto in November 2014. Criticism: an underwhelming lunch (July 2022). The newest detailed review is May 2025.
chef_bio.philosophy: "As chefs, we handle fish, so we cannot make sweets with the same hands" — so wagashi come from a confectioner (2015 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Suppon soup; seasonal kaiseki; chirashi sushi.

anecdotes.text: 2015 (in a 2016 review): "The reason they opened this restaurant is simply because of the good well water available. Indeed, the foundation of cooking is water."

July 2020: "When I inquired about the significance of the pine needles, I learned that they create a gap to prevent the napkin from sticking to the chilled beer… while also symbolizing 'waiting' for the guests."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 二條ふじ田、日本料理、中京区二条寺町東入、京都市役所前から274m、月・火・木・金・土17:00〜21:00、水・日曜休み、カード可 (JCB・AMEX・Diners)、個室あり、禁煙、公式サイト nijo-fujita.com。口コミ (2010年12月〜2025年5月、英語・日本語): コースは6,000円から (2010年)、1万円のコース (2020年7月)、すっぽんのすまし汁、すっぽんの卵、conger eelの土瓶蒸し、子持ち鮎、金目鯛と胡桃豆腐 (2015年)、鱧の梅肉、鱧の子、Kamoなすの炊いたん (2020年7月)、冬の丸鍋と蒸し寿司 (KBS京都の番組、2014年)、締めのちらし寿司と赤だし、店主の実家の菓子司の和菓子と抹茶、井戸水がよくてこの地で開いた (2015年)、店主と奥さん、若いスタッフ、昼は物足りなかったとの声 (2022年7月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Quiet counter; book ahead.

kyoto_yubahan_shinise.gf_detail: Ask. The shop describes yuba as the film that forms on heated soy milk made from soybeans (shop site); no sauce is sold with it in the sources, and no allergen or cross-contact information is given. Bring your own wheat-free soy sauce.
kyoto_yubahan_shinise.vegan_detail: Ask. Plain yuba is made from soy milk (shop site), but no vegan claim is sourced; botan yuba is wrapped around ginkgo nuts and lily bulb (shop site) — ask how it is seasoned.
kyoto_yubahan_shinise.hours_raw: Takeaway only — a yuba maker and shop, no seating. Mon–Wed and Fri–Sun 8:00–17:00; closed Thursday (Tabelog; shop site). Yuba is ready by about 10:00, and calling ahead to reserve is advised (May 2026); botan yuba must be reserved (shop site). Bring a cooler bag and ice packs — the fresh yuba must be kept cold (June 2025, May 2026). Cash only: no cards or e-money (Tabelog). Shipping within Japan on request (shop site). Founded 1716 (yubahan.com); family succession not sourced. On Fuyamachi-dori, north of Oike, about five minutes from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Station exit 9 (shop site).
kyoto_yubahan_shinise.notes: [Yuba · takeaway · Fuyamachi-Oike] A yuba maker founded in 1716, selling fresh yuba to take away from a workshop-like shop on Fuyamachi north of Oike: sashimi yuba, kumiage yuba, sheet yuba, and botan yuba by reservation. Samples while you wait. No seating. Cash only; bring a cooler bag. Closed Thursday. Founded 1716 (yubahan.com); family succession not sourced.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop site: 「1716年（享保元年）創業のゆばの製造・小売専門店」, a yuba maker and retailer founded in 1716, making yuba by the stone-mill method handed down since its founding. Family succession not sourced.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the shop site: yuba made by the stone-ground method passed down since the founding.
chef_bio.specialty: Sashimi yuba; kumiage yuba; botan yuba.

anecdotes.text: A June 2025 visitor found the noren up but no one in front; after calling out, an older woman came out, offered three kinds of yuba to taste, and sold a pack of sashimi yuba for ¥1,620, carried home in a cooler bag.
A May 2026 visitor advises calling ahead, as the shop does not look open even with the noren up, and buying a cooler bag before going; the yuba is ready by about 10:00.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 1716年（享保元年）創業のゆばの製造・小売専門店、創業以来の石臼挽きの製法、さしみゆば1棹1,500円・汲み上げゆば1パック1,200円・引き上げゆば5枚1,000円・牡丹ゆば1個300円 (税抜)、牡丹ゆばは要予約、8時〜17時、木曜定休、地方発送可、京都市役所前駅9番出口から徒歩5分。食べログ: 豆腐料理、中京区麩屋町通御池上ル上白山町250、カード・電子マネー不可。口コミ (2025年6月・2026年5月、英語): 試食あり、さしみゆば1,620円、保冷バッグと保冷剤が必要、10時ごろにはゆばができている、事前に電話で予約するとよい。家族の継承の情報はなし。

cultural_comfort.note: Takeaway only. Call out at the door if no one is in front; samples are offered. Bring cash and a cooler bag. No English evidence found.

kyoto_windy_coffee.gf_detail: Ask. A coffee-only menu (April 2025, April 2026); the coffee ice cream’s ingredients are not described.
kyoto_windy_coffee.vegan_detail: Ask. Coffee only; blend coffee comes with dairy-type creamers (April 2025), and the Wiener coffee with whipped cream (December 2024). Black coffee is the safe order; no vegan claim is sourced.
kyoto_windy_coffee.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 7:00–16:00; closed Sunday and holidays; may change (Tabelog). Cash only (Tabelog; April 2025). No PCs or tablets (April 2025). Counter and tables for two to four, on the second floor of a small building (Tabelog; April 2025). About seven minutes on foot from the Kawaramachi Gojo bus stop (April 2025).
kyoto_windy_coffee.notes: [Kissaten · Gojo, Higashiyama] A coffee-only kissaten upstairs near Gojo, open since 1972 and roasting its own beans since 1982: a mild, deep house blend brewed through cloth, single origins and coffee ice cream, with talk about roasting from the master. Opens at 7:00, closes at 16:00; cash only; no laptops.

chef_bio.background: Per reviews: opened in 1972 and began roasting its own beans in 1982 (April 2025); run by an older couple (December 2024).

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 visitor had the house blend for ¥650 — dark in colour but mild — and talked roasting with the master.
An April 2025 visitor came on a weekday at 14:30, after a museum at Shichijo, and had the blend in a gold-rimmed floral cup in a quiet room.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: カフェ、東山区本町1-48 本町ビル2F、月〜土7:00〜16:00、日曜・祝日休み、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、カウンター席とテーブル席。口コミ (2024年12月〜2026年4月、英語): 1972年開業、1982年から自家焙煎、現金のみ、パソコン・タブレットの使用不可、コーヒーだけのメニュー、コーヒーアイス、ブレンドにクリーム2つ、金縁の花柄のカップ、ネルドリップ、ウインナーコーヒー850円、グアテマラ800円、年配の夫婦が営む、ブレンド650円、マスターと焙煎の話。

cultural_comfort.note: Bring cash; leave the laptop in the bag. Coffee only — no food beyond coffee ice cream. No English evidence found.

kyoto_gyoza_nikomi_sakanaya_sushi_shin.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat-wrapped gyoza, miso and vinegar dipping sauces, soy-simmered beef-tendon stew, kara-age, sushi with soy sauce (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_gyoza_nikomi_sakanaya_sushi_shin.vegan_detail: Not vegan: meat gyoza, beef-tendon stew with egg, kara-age, fish sushi (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_gyoza_nikomi_sakanaya_sushi_shin.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–15:00 (last order 14:00) and 17:00–22:00 (last order 21:00); closed New Year’s Day (Tabelog). Two counters under one roof: Gyoza to Nikomi (31 seats — 17 at the counter, 14 at tables) and the 8-seat Sakana-ya Sushi Shin sushi counter (shop site); sushi can be ordered from the gyoza side on a paper sheet (July 2026). The limited lunch can sell out (June 2026); busy at lunch (September 2026). Cards and e-money; no QR (Tabelog). On the first floor of SUINA Muromachi, Shijo-Muromachi, about three minutes from Karasuma and Shijo stations (shop site; March 2026).
kyoto_gyoza_nikomi_sakanaya_sushi_shin.notes: [Gyoza & sushi · SUINA Muromachi] Two counters on the ground floor of SUINA Muromachi at Shijo-Muromachi: gyoza with miso or vinegar-and-pepper dips and beef-tendon stew as rice sets, and a small U-shaped sushi counter with generous nigiri and a friendly chef. Sushi can be ordered from the gyoza side. Open daily, lunch and dinner.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop site and reviews: a gyoza-and-stew counter and an 8-seat sushi counter side by side at SUINA Muromachi, the Kyoto Keizai Center building opened in 2019 (July 2026).

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 regular on an eighth visit had the gyoza and nikomi set for ¥1,200, with a choice of miso, vinegar-soy or yuzu dips, and found the stew packed with meat.
A July 2026 diner came in through the gyoza noren and found a paper sheet at the counter for ordering sushi from next door.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 餃子と煮込み31席 (カウンター17席・テーブル14席)、魚屋鮨しんカウンター8席、下京区四条室町東入函谷鉾町78 SUINA室町1F。食べログ: 居酒屋・餃子・寿司、毎日11:00〜15:00 (L.O.14:00)・17:00〜22:00 (L.O.21:00)、元日休み、カード・電子マネー可、QR 不可、2019年3月16日オープン。口コミ (2025年7月〜2026年10月、英語): 餃子と煮込み定食1,200〜1,300円、味噌だれと酢こしょう、ご飯大盛り無料、鉄板の牛すじ煮込みに半熟卵、冷やしトマト、紙で寿司も注文できる、コの字のカウンターの寿司、ネタが大きく気さくな大将、限定ランチは売り切れも、鉄板の餃子の定食。

cultural_comfort.note: Solo diners usually sit at the counter; ask for the paper sheet to order sushi from the gyoza side. No English evidence found.

kyoto_tea_lounge_isola.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: 16 small obanzai with miso soup, Saikyo-miso grilled fish, rice balls with meat miso, and parfaits with crushed pie and granola (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_tea_lounge_isola.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the gozen centres on grilled salmon and includes meat miso and Caprese; parfaits use ice cream and cream (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_tea_lounge_isola.hours_raw: Daily 11:30–19:00 (last order 18:00) (Tabelog). The colourful gozen lunch is served in two seatings, 11:30 and 13:30; the dango and mochi set is reserved for after 15:00 (Tabelog). Reserve on the website — weekday walk-ins were turned away (April 2026), and a Sunday was fully booked a month ahead (June 2026). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 22 seats with sofas and a terrace; free Wi-Fi; wheelchair accessible; children welcome (Tabelog). Second floor of the MOKU KYOTO building at Shijo-Muromachi; Gion Matsuri floats can be seen from the window seats (Tabelog; July 2026).
kyoto_tea_lounge_isola.notes: [Obanzai lunch & tea · Shijo-Muromachi] A second-floor tea lounge at Shijo-Muromachi serving a colourful lunch of 16 bite-size obanzai with grilled salmon, charcoal-grilled rice balls and miso soup, with tea you roast yourself over charcoal; seasonal parfaits in the afternoon. Lunch seatings at 11:30 and 13:30 — book online. Caffè Terrace ISOLA at Daimaru is its sister café.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a tea lounge on the second floor of the MOKU KYOTO building at Shijo-Muromachi, opened 3 March 2025. Caffè Terrace ISOLA at Daimaru Kyoto, already listed, comes from the same team.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per Tabelog: self-roasted tea enjoyed with all the senses, after the Zen phrase "reidan jichi".

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 diner who booked a month ahead roasted tea leaves in a pot over charcoal for about a minute, with the staff explaining in a Kyoto accent; walk-ins were sent to the 13:30 seating.
A July 2026 repeat visitor, back after a year, noted the dishes change with the seasons and that the window seats look onto the Gion Matsuri floats.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: カフェ、下京区函谷鉾町77 MOKU KYOTOビル2F、毎日11:30〜19:00 (L.O.18:00)、彩り御膳は11:30と13:30の二部制、団子と餅のセットは15時以降予約可、ウェブ予約、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、22席、テラス席、無料 Wi-Fi、車椅子可、子ども可、2025年3月3日オープン、禅の言葉にちなむ、自分で焙じるお茶。口コミ (2026年4月〜10月、英語): 16種のおばんざいの彩り御膳とお茶のセット3,300円、西京焼きや青森のサーモン、炭火の焼きおにぎり、肉味噌のおにぎり、味噌汁、デザート、炭火で茶葉を焙じる、夏は冷茶の飲み比べ、平日も予約なしでは入れない、窓から祇園祭の山鉾、丸ごと桃のパフェ2,200円。

cultural_comfort.note: Book the 11:30 or 13:30 lunch seating online; the staff walk you through roasting the tea. No English evidence found.

kyoto_geshary_coffee_raku.gf_detail: Ask. Black Geisha coffee, lattes and soft serve may suit; desserts and toppings are not described (2025–2026 reviews). No gluten information.
kyoto_geshary_coffee_raku.vegan_detail: Ask. Black coffee is plant-based, but lattes, shakes and soft serve use dairy; no plant milk mentioned (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_geshary_coffee_raku.hours_raw: Daily 9:00–18:00; hours may change (Tabelog). Order at the counter, then choose a seat in the garden, tea room, annex or the skylit basement (March–April 2026). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). Coffee tasting at the gate and Geisha beans for sale (December 2025). Opened 1 November 2025 next to Yasaka Koshindo, on the walk towards Kiyomizu-dera (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_geshary_coffee_raku.notes: [Geisha coffee · by Yasaka Koshindo] A temple-like gate opens onto a garden estate where every cup is Geisha coffee: pricey single-farm pours, Geisha soft serve and shakes, drunk in the garden, a tea room or a skylit concrete basement. Open daily.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site and Tabelog: the Kyoto shop of GESHARY COFFEE (GESHARY COFFEE INC.), a Geisha-coffee specialist whose other shop is in Hibiya, Tokyo; opened 1 November 2025 in a mansion-style estate of several buildings around a Japanese garden, with more seating areas planned (gesharycoffee.com; March 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Geisha coffee, whose quality depends on terroir — soil, rain, temperature and altitude (gesharycoffee.com).

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 visitor on the way to Kiyomizu-dera walked in thinking it was a lantern-hung temple, and found the long wait was for beans roasted to order.
A March 2026 guest sat in the concrete basement, where trees rise to a round hole in the ceiling that lets the sky in.
A regular of the Hibiya shop came to see the Kyoto one in March 2026 and found the atmosphere entirely different.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: カフェ、東山区下河原通高台寺塔之前上ル金園町390-2、毎日 9:00〜18:00、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、個室あり、2025年11月1日開店、公式サイトあり。公式サイト: 「受け継がれてきた伝統に新たな感性が溶け合う京都。」「意匠を凝らした店内でゆっくりとお過ごしいただけます。」、店舗は日比谷と洛の2店、© GESHARY COFFEE INC.。口コミ (2025年11月〜2026年5月、英語): 八坂庚申堂の隣、寺のような門の先に庭園と離れのある屋敷、ゲイシャ種のコーヒー専門 (FINCA SOPHIA など、1杯2,000円ほどから)、アイスコーヒー2,650円、ラテ、ゲイシャのソフトクリーム、エスプレッソシェイク、360円の甘味、レモンのデザート、庭・茶室・離れ・空の見える地下の席、入口で試飲、豆の販売、日比谷の店の姉妹店。

cultural_comfort.note: Order at the counter, then pick a seat; cards and QR.

existence.note: Tabelog listing and official site; reviews through May 2026.

kyoto_kuguri_nabe_roppakuya.gf_detail: Ask. Sashimi, salt-grilled ayu and the pork hot pot with yuzu may suit, but the special broth, tempura and yuba rice bowl are likely to involve soy or wheat (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews). No gluten information.
kyoto_kuguri_nabe_roppakuya.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a pork hot pot and seafood izakaya (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_kuguri_nabe_roppakuya.hours_raw: Daily 17:00–24:00 (last order 23:30); closing days not fixed (Tabelog). Reservations accepted and advised — can be hard to book (Tabelog; April 2025). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 35 seats in private-feeling rooms for 2–20 in a long, narrow machiya with steep stairs; the counter feels like a passage (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews). Non-smoking (Tabelog). 3 min walk from Hankyu Karasuma Stn.
kyoto_kuguri_nabe_roppakuya.notes: [Pork hot pot izakaya · Shijo-Muromachi, late] A rambling machiya of hidden rooms serving its signature Rokuhaku Kurobuta kuguri nabe — pork swished through yuzu-bright broth — plus sashimi, karasumi, hamo in season and plenty of sake, until midnight. Book ahead.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: an izakaya in a renovated Kyoto townhouse whose main dish is kuguri nabe of Rokuhaku Kurobuta pork, with Kyoto vegetables and market seafood. Reviewers in 2025–2026 describe a staircase-filled “eel’s bed” house of private nooks, walls of signatures and a strong sake list.
chef_bio.specialty: Kuguri nabe of Rokuhaku Kurobuta pork.

anecdotes.text: A July 2025 first-timer found the staircases and narrow layout reminiscent of Spirited Away, and singled out the cream cheese and corn tempura.
An April 2026 Golden Week drop-in loved the karasumi but just missed the sake wanted.
A March 2026 diner on the ¥5,500 omakase course was told the kuguri nabe pork was a favourite of figures of the Bakumatsu era.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋・日本料理、中京区室町新町の間四条上ル観音堂町452-1、阪急烏丸駅から徒歩3分、毎日 17:00〜24:00 (L.O.23:30)、不定休、予約可、カード (VISA・Master・JCB・AMEX) 可、電子マネー・QR 不可、35席、個室 (2〜20名)、禁煙、紹介文 (英訳): Rokuhaku Kurobuta のくぐり鍋が看板、特製のだしにしぼりたてのゆず果汁、ゆず胡椒、京の黒七味、おかわり自由のねぎ、京野菜と市場直送の魚介。口コミ (2025年3月〜2026年10月、英語): 改装した京町家、階段の多いうなぎの寝床、個室のような席、壁のサイン、おまかせコース5,500円、豚しゃぶ、しめの湯葉丼、刺身の盛り合わせ、からすみ、冷しゃぶ、クリームチーズととうもろこしの天ぷら、鱧の刺身と天ぷら、鮎の塩焼き、日本酒が豊富。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; private rooms; steep machiya stairs.

kyoto_gion_maruyama_do.gf_detail: Ask. Plain soft serve in a cup may suit; waffles contain wheat and mitarashi dango glaze uses soy (Tabelog; 2021–2025 reviews). No gluten information.
kyoto_gion_maruyama_do.vegan_detail: Not vegan: milk soft serve is the main offer (2021–2025 reviews).
kyoto_gion_maruyama_do.hours_raw: Daily 10:00–18:00; cherry-blossom season 10:00–22:00; open all year, but may close in storm warnings or heavy rain (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), IC cards, nanaco, iD and PayPay (Tabelog). 20 terrace seats; pets welcome on the terrace; take-out; non-smoking (Tabelog; March 2025). In Maruyama Park in front of the weeping cherry, 1 min walk from Yasaka Shrine (Tabelog). Opened 8 June 2018 (Tabelog).
kyoto_gion_maruyama_do.notes: [Soft serve · Maruyama Park] A small stand in front of the park’s famous weeping cherry: sakura soft serve and hanami dango in spring, sweet-potato soft serve and mitarashi dango in autumn, and matcha-and-red-bean swirls year round, eaten on the terrace or by the pond. Pets welcome.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a soft-serve shop in Maruyama Park opened 8 June 2018, calling itself the most popular soft serve in Higashiyama, with seasonal flavours and dango. Reviewers describe a one-person stand with chairs outside (2021–2025).

anecdotes.text: An April 2021 cherry-blossom visitor found the sakura soft serve as pink and pretty as the trees in full bloom.
A July 2024 visitor ate a red bean and matcha swirl for ¥650 by the pond.
A March 2025 visitor shared the rich milk soft serve with a pet on the terrace.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: カフェ、東山区祇園町北側627 円山公園内しだれ桜前、八坂神社から徒歩1分、毎日 10:00〜18:00、桜の季節は 10:00〜22:00、年中無休 (警報や大雨の日は休みの場合あり)、予約不可、カード (VISA・Master・JCB・AMEX・Diners)・交通系IC・nanaco・iD・PayPay 可、テラス20席、ペット可、テイクアウト、禁煙、2018年6月8日開店、紹介文 (英訳): 東山で人気のソフトクリーム、桜の季節は桜のソフトクリームと花見団子、秋はさつまいものソフトクリームとできたてのみたらし団子。口コミ (2021年4月〜2025年3月、英語): 桜色のソフトクリーム、濃厚なミルク、あずきと抹茶のミックス650円、抹茶ワッフル、桜のワッフル、池のそばで、ペットとテラス席。

cultural_comfort.note: Order at the window; terrace seats; pets welcome.

existence.note: Tabelog official listing; latest review March 2025.

kyoto_gochisou_shiyo.gf_detail: Ask. Small seasonal dishes and obanzai are cooked to order with additive-free ingredients (2009 review), and the owner adjusts portions for solo diners (2018), but croquettes are breaded and seasonings use soy. No gluten information.
kyoto_gochisou_shiyo.vegan_detail: Ask. Tofu dishes and vegetable obanzai appear, but dashi is likely and beef and seafood are served (2009–2025 reviews).
kyoto_gochisou_shiyo.hours_raw: Monday and Thursday–Sunday 17:30–22:00 (last order 21:15); closed Tuesday and Wednesday; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, by phone (Tabelog; December 2020). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). Nine counter seats; shoes off at the entrance; non-smoking (Tabelog; August 2025). Ground floor of the Oshikoji Mansion, with only a small sign and noren (Tabelog; November 2010).
kyoto_gochisou_shiyo.notes: [Counter cooking · Sakaimachi-Oike, cash only] A hidden nine-seat counter behind a noren, where a long-serving owner cooks seasonal small dishes, obanzai and famous croquettes and pours well-chosen sake and Burgundy. Shoes off; book by phone. Closed Tuesday and Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per reviewers: a counter restaurant running for decades (August 2025), where a seasoned proprietress cooks and serves at a clay-walled counter with washi lights (2010–2014), welcoming regulars like family and adjusting portions for one (2018–2020).
chef_bio.philosophy: Additive-free ingredients and real flavour without pretension (October 2009).

anecdotes.text: A 2010 reviewer noted that actress Tae Kimura had named it a favourite eatery in the Nikkei on 30 October 2010.
A regular of 2018–2020, still coming during the pandemic, likened each Kyoto visit to stopping by an older sister’s home.
An August 2025 first-timer, brought by a regular, drank a Burgundy picked by the owner with dishes from obanzai to beef.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 日本料理、中京区堺町通御池上ル扇屋町646 押小路マンション 1F、月・木〜日 17:30〜22:00 (L.O.21:15)、火・水休み、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、カウンター9席、禁煙、貸切可。口コミ (2009年10月〜2025年8月、英語): 何十年も続く店、靴を脱いで上がるカウンター、土壁と和紙の灯り、ベテランの女将が料理と接客、旬の小鉢とおばんざいから牛肉まで、名物の3種のコロッケ (春菊と帆立のクリーム、れんこんと肉など)、聖護院近くの豆腐、添加物のない食材、京都や滋賀などの日本酒と選べる酒器、和食に合うワイン、焼酎、2010年の新聞で Tae Kimura のお気に入りの店として紹介。

cultural_comfort.note: Cash only; nine seats; shoes off; book by phone.

kyoto_sinamo_teramachi.gf_detail: Not GF: a pizza house — square sinamo-style pizza, pasta and focaccia; no gluten-free crust mentioned (official site; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_sinamo_teramachi.vegan_detail: Ask. Appetiser plates are heavy on Kyoto vegetables (slow-roasted kintoki carrot, pumpkin), but cheese, ham and oysters feature widely (2026 reviews).
kyoto_sinamo_teramachi.hours_raw: Daily 11:30–16:00 and 17:30–23:00; closing days not fixed (Tabelog). Lunch set menu 11:30–14:00 last order (official site, October 2026). Reservations online 24 hours to 30 days ahead (official site). No cover charge (Tabelog original チャージ料ナシ). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), IC cards and Rakuten Edy (Tabelog). 28 seats: 20 at tables, 8 on sofas; non-smoking; English menu (Tabelog). Groups of minors only are turned away in the evening (official site, April 2026). Take-out and mail order (official site). Opened 15 April 1999 (Tabelog; official site). 2 min walk from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn exit 11.
kyoto_sinamo_teramachi.notes: [Pizza and wine · Teramachi-Nijo] A warm, lamp-lit Teramachi favourite since 1999: square sinamo-style pizzas such as blue cheese and honey, Kyoto-vegetable appetiser plates, truffle omelette and keenly priced wine, with good-value lunch sets. No cover charge.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site and Tabelog: a single pizza and casual-wine restaurant opened 15 April 1999, marking its 27th year in April 2026, guided by “simple, natural, modern” and its trademarked sinamo-style pizza; it also sells take-out and by mail order.
chef_bio.philosophy: Simple, natural, modern — brightening Japan with sinamo-style pizza (official site).

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 food blogger was teased by a friend for not knowing the orange-lit Teramachi place, and arrived first through the door at opening.
A January 2026 lunch guest praised kintoki carrot slow-roasted for an hour, sweet without added sugar.
An April 2026 birthday group found nearly every table ordering the birthday plate, which spoiled the surprise.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ピザ・イタリアン・ワインバー、中京区寺町通二条下ル妙満寺前町454-3 呉波ビル 1F、市役所前駅11番出口から徒歩2分、毎日 11:30〜16:00、17:30〜23:00、不定休、予約可、チャージ料ナシ、カード (VISA・Master・JCB・AMEX・Diners)・交通系IC・楽天Edy 可、28席 (テーブル20、ソファ8)、禁煙、英語のメニュー、1999年4月15日開店。公式サイト: カジュアルワイン＆シナモ式ピザ、「シンプル･ナチュラル･モダン」、シナモ式ピザは商標登録済み、2026年4月15日に開店満27周年、ランチ・セットメニュー (11:30-14:00 L.O.)、国産キノコとすだちのピザ、自家製豚ハムと季節野菜ピクルスのピザ、夜の部は未成年者だけの来店は断る、テイクアウト、通販。口コミ (2025年11月〜2026年9月、英語): オレンジの灯りの細長い店内、ブルーチーズとはちみつ、れんこん、カルボナーラ、マルゲリータのピザ、京野菜の前菜、黒トリュフのオムレツ、牡蠣のグラタン、カキフライ、生ハムとサラミ、牛ほほ肉の赤ワイン煮、昼のセット、スパークリングワイン500円。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu; no cover charge; book online.

existence.note: Tabelog listing and official site (news October 2026); reviews through September 2026.

kyoto_gion_hanamai.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: the restaurant does not accept bookings from guests with gluten allergies (Tabelog).
kyoto_gion_hanamai.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the restaurant does not accept vegetarians or pescatarians (Tabelog).
kyoto_gion_hanamai.hours_raw: Mon, Fri, Sat, Sun and holidays: entry 11:30–14:00 and 18:00–19:00 (the times are entry times); closed Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, with occasional other closures (Tabelog). One group a day at lunch and one at dinner (2025–26 reviews). Bookings are refused for guests who cannot eat fish or raw fish, vegetarians, pescatarians and those with gluten allergies; a booking may be cancelled 15 minutes after the time without contact; cancellation policy applies (Tabelog). Service charge 10%, no cover (Tabelog Japanese original 「サービス料10％、チャージ料なし」). Cards; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 6 counter seats of a single slab of Yoshino cypress (Tabelog; May 2025 review). 2 min from the main gate of Yasaka Shrine (Tabelog).
kyoto_gion_hanamai.notes: [Kaiseki · Yasaka Shrine] A six-seat cypress counter by Yasaka Shrine where the owner-chef serves just one group at lunch and one at dinner — refined Kyoto kaiseki, ¥10,000–42,000 plus 10%. Strict dietary policy: no vegetarian or gluten-free bookings.

chef_bio.background: Trained in Kyoto and Osaka and worked at the Kyoto Hotel Okura annex, Awata Sanso and Hoshinoya Kyoto (May 2025 review); relaunched Gion Hanamai in 2024 to serve one group at a time (October 2025 review). An August 2026 guest writes that the chef has earned a Michelin star.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Ichigo ichie" — the last dish is decided by the guests of the day (August 2026 review).

anecdotes.text: An October 2025 returning guest was told, unprompted, that the Rococo beer enjoyed on the first visit was in stock that day.
A February 2026 visitor came on the tip of a stranger at the next table in a Tokyo restaurant.
Another February 2026 guest was sent off with a bottle of sake as a souvenir.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 祇園 華舞、日本料理、東山区清井町494-2、八坂神社の正門から徒歩2分、月・金・土・日・祝日 入店 11:30〜14:00・18:00〜19:00、火・水・木曜休み、魚・生魚が食べられない人、ベジタリアン、ペスカタリアン、グルテンアレルギーの人の予約は不可、サービス料10%、チャージ料なし、カード可、電子マネー・QR 不可、カウンター6席。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 1日1組の ichigo ichie、店主の Miyako さんは京都と大阪で修業し、ホテルや旅館で経験、2024年に再出発、Yoshino の檜の一枚板のカウンター、昼10,000円・18,000円、夜24,200円・42,350円 (2025年5月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Private counter for one group; strict dietary policy (Tabelog).

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through August 2026.

kyoto_kakure_robata_gaburi.gf_detail: Ask. Straw-grilled bonito is served with salt (October 2026 review) and much is grilled plain; tempura and kara-age are wheat.
kyoto_kakure_robata_gaburi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a seafood and grill izakaya (2026 reviews).
kyoto_kakure_robata_gaburi.hours_raw: Mon and Wed 17:00–02:00; Tue, Thu, Fri, Sat and the day before a holiday 17:00–03:00; Sun, holidays and the day after a holiday 17:00–22:00 (Tabelog). The 2nd-floor tables close earlier (17:00–23:30) than the 1st-floor counter; may close early, so call ahead (Tabelog). Cover ¥528 (Tabelog Japanese original 「お通し代528円（税込）」). Cards and QR; no e-money (Tabelog). Counter downstairs; sunken-kotatsu private rooms upstairs (May 2026 review); heated tobacco only, at the counter (June 2026 review). Down a back alley east of Karasuma-Bukkoji, 2 min from Shijo (Tabelog).
kyoto_kakure_robata_gaburi.notes: [Robatayaki · Shijo-Karasuma] A back-alley robata where bonito, octopus and Omi beef are seared over burning straw at the counter and snacks go on the shichirin; fish from Maizuru, a good sake list, and open to 2–3 am. About ¥4,000–8,000.

chef_bio.background: The owner picks special sake from the back for regulars (October 2026 review). Fish shipped from Maizuru port (TableCheck).

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 couple chose it for an anniversary after a company banquet there, for straw-grilled bonito, octopus and Omi beef seasoned only with salt.
A June 2026 diner watched the chef wrap young corn in its husk, batter it and fry it.
A November 2026 first-timer was surprised the turban-shell starter was cooked over charcoal.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 隠れ炉端家がぶり、居酒屋・魚介料理・炉端焼き、下京区上柳町315-20、阪急烏丸駅・地下鉄四条駅から徒歩2分、月・水 17:00〜翌2:00、火・木・金・土・祝日の前日 17:00〜翌3:00、日・祝日・祝日の翌日 17:00〜22:00、2階のテーブル席は23:30まで、お通し528円、カード・QR 可、電子マネー不可。TableCheck: Maizuru 港の魚、にぎりと藁焼き。口コミ (2026年、英語): カツオの藁焼きを塩で、タコ、Omi の牛肉、七輪でサザエ、黒毛和牛、イカ、ホッケ、鱧のコース、掘りごたつの個室。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter downstairs; private rooms upstairs.

kyoto_coffee_tsutaya_rokkaku.gf_detail: Ask. Coffee and pudding; apple pie, cookies and Napolitan pasta are wheat (2026 reviews).
kyoto_coffee_tsutaya_rokkaku.vegan_detail: Ask. Black straight coffees; the pudding and cakes have egg and dairy (2026 reviews).
kyoto_coffee_tsutaya_rokkaku.hours_raw: Daily 9:00–18:00 (L.O. 17:30); closed on holidays; breakfast orders until 12:00; occasional closures when short of staff; hours may change (Tabelog). Phone bookings 8:30–18:00 (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). Smoking allowed throughout except two terrace seats (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Ground floor of the Royal Plaza building at Higashinotoin-Rokkaku (Tabelog).
kyoto_coffee_tsutaya_rokkaku.notes: [Kissa · Karasuma] A blue-tiled retro coffee house in business since 1986, with cups lining the walls, a firm classic pudding and straight coffees — and a pilgrimage spot for fans of the anime "The Eccentric Family". Under ¥1,500; smoking allowed inside.

chef_bio.background: A long-established coffee shop in business since 1986 (July 2026 review), known to fans of the anime Uchoten Kazoku (April 2026 reviews).

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 visitor came back after a year for the pudding that had sold out before, waited 30 minutes at noon, and finally got it.
A March 2026 guest ordering tea and coffee was surprised to get biscotti on the side.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 珈琲 蔦家、喫茶店、中京区東洞院六角御射山町260 ロイヤルプラザ1F、毎日 9:00〜18:00 (L.O. 17:30)、祝日休み、モーニングは12時まで、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、テラス2席以外は喫煙可。口コミ (2026年、英語): 1986年からの老舗、青いタイルの外観、壁のカップ、昔ながらの固めのプリン (約500円)、ストレートコーヒー、アップルパイ、ナポリタン、アニメ「Uchoten Kazoku」のファン。

cultural_comfort.note: Smoking inside; busy at noon.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_kyo_no_okazu_yaoichi.gf_detail: Ask. Steamed vegetables with salt, yuzu pepper or miso, rice and tofu dishes (2026 reviews); dashi and soy are likely, and kara-age is wheat.
kyoto_kyo_no_okazu_yaoichi.vegan_detail: Ask. Vegetable-led sets, some meat-free (June 2026 review), but dashi, egg and chicken appear in many dishes (2026 reviews).
kyoto_kyo_no_okazu_yaoichi.hours_raw: Mon, Wed–Sun 11:00–15:30 (food L.O. 15:00) and 17:00–21:00 (food L.O. 20:30); closed Tuesdays; hours may change (Tabelog). The daily side-dish lunch is limited to 10 servings (June and October 2026 reviews). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners) and e-money; no QR (Tabelog). Counter for solo diners and tables; non-smoking; takeaway (Tabelog; October 2026 review). 2nd floor of 京都八百一本館, above the vegetable market, on Higashinotoin south of Sanjo (Tabelog).
kyoto_kyo_no_okazu_yaoichi.notes: [Vegetable washoku · Karasuma] The restaurant above the 京都八百一 greengrocer: generous Kyoto vegetable sets of steamed vegetables, small side dishes, multigrain rice and soup, with a few meat mains. About ¥2,000–3,000 at lunch.

roles: Restaurant of 京都八百一本館
chef_bio.background: Opened 20 April 2013 (Tabelog); run by the well-known vegetable shop downstairs (August 2026 review), a sister of SAVORY on the 3rd floor.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 regular arrived early and got one of the ten daily side-dish lunches — nine small dishes — before bookings filled the room.
A June 2026 diner who dislikes tofu and mekabu was won over by the two together and found the meat-free lunch filling.

kyoto_ikkyuan_maruyama_park.vegan_detail: Ask. Dango and warabi mochi with kinako and anko are not described as vegan; several sweets come with soft-serve or ice cream, and the summer matcha latte uses soy milk (own site; 2026 reviews).

PayPay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). 90 seats inside, on a raised tatami area and outside on red-draped benches under parasols (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Takeaway; English menu (Tabelog). Prices revised from 1 October 2026 (own site). The “華団” set was paused 27 March–5 April 2026 for the cherry-blossom crowds (own site).
kyoto_ikkyuan_maruyama_park.notes: [Dango café · Maruyama Park, red parasols] A big, relaxed sweets café on the north side of Maruyama Park’s weeping cherry: chewy dango in many flavours, warabi mochi and shaved ice, eaten indoors, on tatami or on red-draped benches under parasols. Order at the counter; tea comes with the dango. Not a vegetarian restaurant — the fucha restaurant 高台寺 一休庵 by Kodai-ji is a different business.

roles: Owner (unnamed; signs the site’s notices as 店主)
chef_bio.background: The café’s site gives its place as the north side of the weeping cherry in Maruyama Park, Gion, and posts notices signed by the owner, such as the October 2026 price revision. No operator or founding date was found.
chef_bio.specialty: Dango in many flavours; warabi mochi.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 visitor strolling from Yasaka Shrine took the six-flavour warabi mochi and a black-sesame shaved ice under a red parasol.
A July 2026 reviewer, out in 35-degree heat, ordered the “華団” set and found a tomato-flavoured dango among the skewers.

kyoto_yasai_ryori_oki_shijo.gf_detail: Some GF options: the shop says it can serve dishes for gluten-free diets and food allergies, and offers allergy-friendly dishes at dinner (own site); Tabelog lists gluten-free options; an October 2025 reviewer confirms GF options. Which dishes are gluten-free is not listed, and all food is prepared in one kitchen (breakfast menu) — tell staff when you order.
kyoto_yasai_ryori_oki_shijo.vegan_detail: Some vegan options: a wide vegan à la carte at dinner and a vegan course on reservation (own site); vegan versions of most breakfast sets with plant-based French toast and vegan egg, plus vegan pancakes and yogurt at the breakfast station (breakfast menu; September 2026); a 2025 reviewer notes vegan dashi and vegan-meat rice bowls. Meat dishes (pork, chicken, beef stew) come from the same kitchen.
kyoto_yasai_ryori_oki_shijo.hours_raw: Daily: breakfast 7:00–10:00 (last orders 9:30), dinner 17:00–23:00 (last orders 22:00); days off irregular (own site). Dinner course on reservation only — message the chef on Instagram (own site). Cards, IC and e-money, some QR (Tabelog). 30 seats: an 8-seat counter and tables (Tabelog). Non-smoking, with a smoking area (Tabelog). Wheelchair accessible; English menu (Tabelog). In the lobby of IMU HOTEL KYOTO, a townhouse-style hotel just east of Shinmachi south of Bukkoji (October 2025; September 2026).
kyoto_yasai_ryori_oki_shijo.notes: [Vegetable cooking · Shinmachi-Bukkoji hotel lobby, vegan and GF] A vegetable-led restaurant in a small townhouse-style hotel: organic produce, a long vegan à la carte with meat as an option, gluten-free and allergy-friendly dishes on request, and a vegan course by reservation. Breakfast sets from 7:00 have vegan versions. Chef Taiki Kataoka, formerly in French kitchens, was a Vegetarian Chance Japan 2020 finalist. One kitchen for everything. Flagged: hotel restaurant (small local hotel).

chef_bio.background: Worked as a chef in French restaurants before this post (own site). Selected as a finalist at the first Vegetarian Chance Japan 2020 (own site; October 2025 review). Plans the menu, cooks and serves (2025 review).
chef_bio.philosophy: Moved by the real needs of vegan and vegetarian guests, the chef works to raise the quality of vegetable cooking so that more people can enjoy eating; harmony between people and nature, using shojin techniques (own site).

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 diner had a 13-dish vegetable course whose main was a mock eel, with three desserts and no animal fat in any sauce or soup.

kyoto_izakaya_charlie_karasuma_oike.notes: [Izakaya · Karasuma-Oike, opened 2025] A small, stylish izakaya in an old Kyoto building with an atrium, popular with a young crowd: playful plates like salmon-roe canapés with wasabi cream, hamachi carpaccio and hayashi rice, most around ¥800. Friendly staff; cash only; book by phone.

chef_bio.background: Opened on 16 February 2025 (Tabelog). Reviewers describe friendly, attentive staff and a mostly twenty-something crowd (April and May 2026). No operator was found.
chef_bio.specialty: Small plates: canapés, carpaccio, hayashi rice.

kyoto_comida_latina_costa.notes: [Mexican and Spanish · Karasuma-Oike, since 2014] A bright, lively upstairs bar-restaurant two minutes from Karasuma-Oike: tacos, birria, nachos from tortillas fried in house, jamón and ajillo, with plenty of tequila, rum and wine cocktails. Lunch on weekdays except Tuesday; open to 1:00. Smoking at the counter. Flagged: operator unknown.

chef_bio.background: Open since 23 November 2014 (Tabelog). An August 2026 reviewer describes the manager guiding a tasting of tequilas. No operator was found.

An August 2026 diner who had only known Doritos-style nachos was won over by the thick, warm house-fried chips.

kyoto_yamanashi_seian.notes: [Bean-paste maker · Higashiyama-Sanjo, since 1920, takeaway only] A family bean-paste maker on the same spot since 1920, now in its third generation, supplying Kyoto’s confectioners and selling an, sweetened beans and black-bean glacé from its shop counter. Takeaway only — no seating; weekdays only.

chef_bio.background: Founded in 1920 (Taisho 9) on the present site by the first president, 山梨福一 (reading not sourced); closed for two years by wartime order from 1944; incorporated in 1960, when the second-generation 山梨龍一 (reading not sourced) became president; the third generation, 山梨彰一, took over in 1997. The building was remodelled in 1932 and 1950; 16 staff (own site).
chef_bio.philosophy: Aims for an that people call truly delicious, made from beans grown year after year by farmers in Hokkaido, Tanba and abroad (own site).

anecdotes.text: A June 2025 reviewer, given white bean paste from here, tried it on bread at a friend’s suggestion.
A February 2026 reviewer felt a little tipsy from the rum in the black-bean glacé.

kyoto_kyo_asobi_gion_kushiyaki.notes: [Yakitori · Gion Shinbashi, Kyoto vegetables and tsukune] A stylish Gion yakitori house by Tatsumi Shrine with counter, sunken-kotatsu and private-room seating: Kyo-akajidori skewers, colourful tsukune and grilled Kyoto vegetables, plus obanzai lunch trays on weekends. ¥500 otoshi.

anecdotes.text: A January 2025 lunch of five tsukune and ten obanzai finished with warm warabi mochi and ice cream.
A September 2025 walk-in ordered six colourful tsukune and six yakitori.
A June 2026 vegetable lover marvelled at the size of the grilled vegetables at the counter.

An October 2025 regular’s favourite is the spinach chicken.
A November 2025 diner had the mini cheese-naan lunch at spice level 3.

kyoto_kobe_beef_teppan_sayaka.notes: [Kobe beef teppanyaki · Nishiki by Daimaru, certified Kobe beef] A calm Kobe-beef-only teppan room steps from Nishiki, certified to serve the beef raw: watch the chef sear it at the counter, or try beef sushi and yukhoe. anecdotes.text: A December 2025 lunch guest learned from the owner how rare officially certified Kobe beef is.
A July 2026 diner tried the steak four ways: rock salt, wasabi, soy and aged garlic soy.
A May 2026 visitor came for Kobe beef sukiyaki and planned to return for the teppanyaki.

kyoto_italian_sakaba_covo.gf_detail: Ask. Pasta, bruschetta and fried dishes alongside salads, cheeses, hams and grilled meat; no gluten information is published (official site; reviews).
kyoto_italian_sakaba_covo.vegan_detail: Ask. Smoked broccoli and homemade pickles are on the menu, but most dishes use meat, fish, cheese or egg (official site; reviews).
kyoto_italian_sakaba_covo.hours_raw: 16:00–24:00 (last food order 23:00, drinks 23:45); closed Tuesday (Tabelog; official site gives 16:00–24:00). Cards (incl. UnionPay) and e-money; no table charge (Tabelog). 32 seats: a 12-seat counter on the ground floor (heated tobacco allowed) and non-smoking tables in the half-basement; private hire for 20–32 (Tabelog; official site). Reservations online (official site; March 2026). Airport Building 1F, a lane off Kawaramachi north of Sanjo (official site). Opened 16 March 2023; renovated by September 2025 (Tabelog; September 2025 review).
kyoto_italian_sakaba_covo.notes: [Italian bar · Kawaramachi-Sanjo lane, cheap wine from 4 pm] A lively back-lane Italian bar near Sanjo opening at 4 pm: smoked broccoli, Caesar salad with a fried egg, red-wine-braised wagyu shank and clay-pot risotto, with bottles from ¥2,500. Counter upstairs, tables below; closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Opened in March 2023 (Tabelog), run by 株式会社COVO, registered at the shop’s address (NTA invoice register). Reviewers (2025–2026) describe a friendly kitchen team and a regular crowd; handy before shows at ROHM Theatre.
chef_bio.philosophy: A place to drink with friends and leave cheerful, with a reasonable bill (official site).

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 regular always orders the Caesar salad, ajillo, prosciutto and carpaccio.
A January 2026 group of thirteen had the ¥6,600 free-drink course and were surprised by the smoked broccoli.
An April 2026 pre-concert stop for one drink turned into red-wine-braised wagyu shank.

kyoto_nagomi_ren_karasuma.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: courses include fried dishes, tuna karaage, wheat-gluten (fu) miso dengaku and red miso soup (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_nagomi_ren_karasuma.vegan_detail: Not vegan: tuna courses — sashimi, yukhoe, grilled collar, negitoro rolls (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_nagomi_ren_karasuma.hours_raw: Daily 17:00–23:30 (food last order 22:30, drinks 23:00); December 31 until 22:00; closed January 1 (Tabelog). Mostly courses with all-you-can-drink, ¥5,000–6,000 (2025–26 reviews); orders by QR code (April 2026). Semi-private rooms divided by curtains, sunken-kotatsu and sofa seating; 32 seats, parties up to 80 (Tabelog; July and December 2025, October 2026). Smoking allowed; no children (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, AMEX); no e-money (Tabelog). A machiya on Karasuma-dori west side at Bukkoji, about three minutes from Shijo Station (Tabelog; December 2025).
kyoto_nagomi_ren_karasuma.notes: [Tuna izakaya · Shijo-Karasuma] A machiya izakaya near Shijo-Karasuma built around Misaki tuna and group courses: sashimi, yukhoe, a salt-grilled tuna collar each, bone-in tuna karaage and negitoro rolls, with all-you-can-drink including three Kirin draft beers, about ¥5,000–6,000. Curtained semi-private rooms. Smoking allowed; no children. Open daily to 23:30.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: an izakaya opened 8 August 2013 on Karasuma-dori at Bukkoji. Hotpepper lists the same address as 三崎屋 四条烏丸店 and describes it as run directly by a tuna wholesaler (まぐろ卸売直営店).
chef_bio.specialty: Misaki tuna courses; salt-grilled tuna collar.

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 year-end party took the ¥6,000 three-hour course; the salt-grilled Misaki-tuna collar, one plate each, was the highlight.
A September 2025 group asked ahead for a birthday plate and, after the regular desserts, received an arranged plate of small cakes at no charge.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋、下京区烏丸通仏光寺西入釘隠町242、毎日17:00〜23:30 (料理L.O.22:30・ドリンクL.O.23:00)、12月31日は22時まで、1月1日休み、カード (VISA・Master・AMEX) 可、電子マネー不可、32席 (宴会80名)、個室あり、喫煙可、子ども不可、2013年8月8日オープン。ホットペッパー: 同じ住所で「三崎屋 四条烏丸店」、まぐろ卸売直営店。口コミ (2025年4月〜2026年10月、英語): マグロのコースと飲み放題、キリンの生ビール3種、刺身3種、ユッケ、マグロのかまの塩焼き、骨付きの唐揚げ、ねぎとろ巻き、5,000〜6,000円、QRコードで注文、カーテンで仕切った半個室、掘りごたつ、誕生日のデザートプレート、四条駅から徒歩3分。

kyoto_tanaka_tsukemono_ho.gf_detail: Ask. Pickles only; Nara-zuke is made with sake lees and the burdock with black mirin, and the bamboo shoots are pickled in dashi (March and April 2026). No allergen information is sourced — ask about soy sauce and other seasonings for each pickle.
kyoto_tanaka_tsukemono_ho.vegan_detail: Ask. Vegetable pickles, but the bamboo shoots are pickled in Kyoto-style dashi (April 2026) and other seasonings are not described; no vegan claim is sourced.
kyoto_tanaka_tsukemono_ho.hours_raw: Takeaway only — a pickle shop, no eating in. Mon–Sat 10:00–17:30; closed Sunday (shop site; Tabelog lists to 18:00). No cards or e-money; QR accepted (Tabelog). Online and fax orders (shop site). Founded 1911 (tanakatsukemono.com); family succession not sourced. On a side street west of Higashioji, south of Sanjo, by a post office — about three minutes from the Higashiyama-Sanjo crossing (March 2026).
kyoto_tanaka_tsukemono_ho.notes: [Kyoto pickles · takeaway · Higashiyama-Sanjo] A pickle shop that has kept its noren in Higashiyama since 1911: shiba-zuke "Yamashiro no Sato", Nara-zuke, burdock, water eggplant and bamboo-shoot pickles, mostly ¥540 a pack. Takeaway only. Closed Sunday. Founded 1911 (tanakatsukemono.com); family succession not sourced.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop site: 「京都・東山で明治四十四年からのれんを守る」 — a Higashiyama pickle shop since 1911. Family succession not sourced.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 regular buys the ¥810 Nara-zuke often, finding it lighter than most yet deep in flavour — good with unadon.

An April 2026 visitor bought four ¥540 packs — shiba-zuke, burdock, water eggplant and bamboo shoots — and noted the same pickles are sold in department-store food halls, but the shop itself is more fun.

kyoto_shin_miura_kiyamachi.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: the mizutaki pot includes wheat gluten (fu) and is eaten with ponzu; fried chicken is also served (2024–26 reviews).
kyoto_shin_miura_kiyamachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chicken hot pot in a long-simmered chicken broth, finished as zosui (2024–26 reviews).
kyoto_shin_miura_kiyamachi.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 17:00–21:30, last entry 19:30; closed Sunday and some irregular days (shop site; Tabelog lists 16:30–22:00). Book by phone, 075-231-1297 (shop site). The summer riverside deck (noryo-yuka) runs 1 May to the end of September (shop site; in 2025 it was extended to 15 October, and an October 2025 diner ate outside). kyoto_shin_miura_kiyamachi.notes: [Mizutaki · Kiyamachi, Kamogawa] A long-established chicken hot-pot house on Kiyamachi by the Kamogawa, said in reviews to date from the early Taisho era and to be the childhood home of actress Mitsuko Mori: a ¥5,100 mizutaki course with a milky, long-simmered broth, the staff tending the pot, and zosui to finish. Riverside deck May to September. Book by phone; last entry 19:30; closed Sunday.

roles: Owner (unnamed), described as warm and friendly (May 2026)
chef_bio.background: Per reviews: a mizutaki restaurant founded in the early Taisho era, in the house where actress Mitsuko Mori grew up (October 2024, January 2025, July 2025). The shop site says it has long been known as 「鳥水炊きの新三浦」.

anecdotes.text: A July 2025 diner had the ¥5,100 mizutaki course on the riverside deck during Gion Matsuri, sipping the broth first with a little salt and finishing with zosui.
A January 2025 diner ate mizutaki in the actress’s childhood room, with shichimi from Nishiki on the table.
A May 2026 visitor, rained off the riverside deck, found the house full and the owner warm and friendly; the finishing zosui was gone in no time.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 古くから「鳥水炊きの新三浦」、17:00〜21:30 (最終入店19:30)、日曜・不定休、電話で予約、納涼床は5月1日〜9月末日 (2025年は10月15日まで延長)。食べログ: 鶏料理・水炊き、中京区木屋町通御池上ル上樵木町491、カード (VISA・Master) 可、電子マネー・QR 不可。口コミ (2024年10月〜2026年8月、英語): 大正初期の創業、女優 Mitsuko Mori の生家、水炊きのコース5,100円 (先付、水炊き、雑炊、果物)、何時間も煮込んだ白濁のスープをまず塩で、骨付きの鶏、つくね、麩、豆腐、葛きり、自家製ポン酢、鶏の大根おろし、きも、雑炊、伏見の酒、温かい店主、10月の川床。

cultural_comfort.note: Book by phone; the staff cook the pot and explain the order — broth first, then chicken, then zosui. No English evidence found.

No photos inside, by a sign (February 2025). A radio instead of background music (March 2026). On Teramachi-dori south of Nijo, near Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Station (Tabelog; August 2026).
kyoto_eight_coffee_ten.notes: [Kissaten · Teramachi-Nijo] A long-running Showa-era coffee shop on Teramachi south of Nijo, run by its master alone, with a radio playing: coffee from ¥400 and a toast set with salad, boiled egg and banana for breakfast. Opens at 8:00. Cash only; no photos inside.

roles: Master (unnamed), who runs the shop alone (2025–26 reviews)
chef_bio.background: Per reviews: a long-established kissaten on Teramachi-dori (December 2025), run single-handed by an older master (September 2025, March 2026).

anecdotes.text: A September 2025 breakfast visitor, finding no breakfast menu, ordered the toast set — toast with butter and jam, salad, half a boiled egg and a piece of banana — and drank the coffee black.
A December 2025 visitor remembered stopping here about 20 years earlier after early-morning pottery sales at a nearby antique shop, and found it unchanged; coffee was ¥400.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 喫茶店、中京区寺町通二条下ル榎木町100-1、毎日8:00〜17:30、不定休、カード不可。口コミ (2025年2月〜2026年8月、英語): マスターが一人で営む、店内撮影禁止の貼り紙、昭和の雰囲気、BGM の代わりにラジオ、トーストセット (サラダ、ゆで卵半分、バナナ、バターとジャム)、ホットコーヒー400円、アイスコーヒー450円、カフェオレ、フルーティーなホットコーヒー、アイスティー、約20年前と変わらない店、京都市役所前駅の近く。

kyoto_nittodo.gf_detail: Ask. A coffee stand: reviews mention only drinks (coffee, café au lait, coffee milk, iced matcha latte); no food or gluten information.
kyoto_nittodo.vegan_detail: Ask. Black coffee is available, but the signature drinks are made with Kyoto milk (2023–2026 reviews); no plant milk is mentioned.
kyoto_nittodo.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon, Wed–Sun 10:00–18:00; closed Tuesday; hours may change (a travel guide lists irregular closures). No reservations. Order at the counter on the 1st floor (a shop of tools, stationery and crafts), then sit upstairs — 10 seats on the 2nd floor looking at the Yasaka pagoda (August 2026). Coffee milk also to take away in a glass milk bottle. Cards, e-money and QR codes. Under ¥1,000.
kyoto_nittodo.notes: [Coffee stand · Yasaka pagoda, coffee milk above a goods shop] Order downstairs among the notebooks, ceramics and tools, then take your coffee up to a quiet 2nd-floor room facing the Yasaka pagoda. Known for coffee milk in a retro glass bottle (also to go). Under ¥1,000. One 2024 visitor found the café au lait flat. Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: A shop in a renovated old house beside the Yasaka pagoda selling everyday tools and goods from around Japan, with a coffee stand (rurubu travel guide). Reviewers describe clothing, ceramics, stationery and notebooks downstairs and a calm café upstairs that stays quiet in a busy tourist area (September 2024; August 2026). The operator is not named in the sources.
chef_bio.specialty: Coffee milk in a glass milk bottle.

anecdotes.text: March 2023: "They blend 5 carefully selected types of beans. The milk used is special milk provided by Clover Farm located in Kyoto."
August 2026: "The second floor was cool, private, and had a fantastic view of the Yasaka Pagoda right in front of me."
March 2024: "Unfortunately, there was no aroma or flavor of coffee at all. It seemed they reheated pre-dripped coffee in a pot and combined it with milk."

kyoto_sticks_coffee_oshikoji.notes: [Coffee and sweets · Oshikoji, a Hyogo roaster in an old townhouse] A calm, wood-lined café in a 150-year-old townhouse from a roaster based in rural Hyogo: choose your beans, then add a retro pudding, crunchy churros or a seasonal kakigori. chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviewers: opened 8 April 2023, the renamed successor of the popular Fuyacho Une no (December 2025; March 2026); reviewers mention a Michelin Bib Gourmand listing (October–December 2025) and an owner particular about the broth who cooks, mixes drinks and whisks the breakfast matcha (October 2025; June–August 2026).

A three-time regular in June 2026 returns whenever the craving for the ¥3,000 breakfast, ending in warabi mochi and matcha, comes back.
A March 2026 party who used to go to Une no booked the private room under the new name.

kyoto_kyo_yuba_mitakyu_kiyomizu.notes: [Yuba · on the slope to Kiyomizu-dera] The first restaurant of a family yuba maker of about a century: a gentle tasting gozen of six yuba, from creamy fresh yuba to a yuba rice bowl, plus nama-fu and soy lattes, upstairs above a busy take-away counter. Open daily.

chef_bio.background: Per the maker’s crowdfunding page: 三田久 has made yuba for about 100 years since the great-grandfather of 三田竜太, the planned fourth-generation head, founded it; the third-generation president runs a small factory near Kyoto Station, and this Kiyomizu shop, with take-away below and a restaurant above, is the business’s first place to eat (makuake.com). Opened 23 January 2023 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Yuba of carefully chosen domestic soybeans and clean Kyoto groundwater (makuake.com).

anecdotes.text: A March 2025 diner tasted six yuba, each served with a photo of the yuba used, and liked the fresh yuba best.
A January 2026 guest, recovering from a night out, found the gentle yuba set soothing on the stomach.

kyoto_gonotora_shijo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: charcoal-grilled chicken, fish and dashi-based obanzai (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_gonotora_shijo.hours_raw: Daily including holidays 15:00–24:00 (last orders food 23:00, drinks 23:30; grilled and fried dishes until about 22:00); closing days not fixed (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; same-day cancellations generally not accepted (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). 36 seats: counter, tatami and sunken kotatsu; private hire for 20–50; smoking allowed; wheelchair accessible; free Wi-Fi (Tabelog; June 2026). A big SOU・SOU noren and a tiger mural by the artist Hideki Kimura (Tabelog). Opened 28 March 2014 (Tabelog). Down an alley 3 min from Karasuma Stn.
kyoto_gonotora_shijo.notes: [Charcoal grill and sake · Shijo-Karasuma, late] Through a big SOU・SOU noren to a tiger mural: charcoal-grilled chicken and fish, inventive obanzai such as shibazuke potato salad, and a deep sake list, open from 15:00 to midnight. Smoking allowed. Same-day cancellations not accepted.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a charcoal-grill and obanzai izakaya opened 28 March 2014, run by 株式会社ＡＦＬＯ・ＸＬ (NTA invoice register), with a SOU・SOU noren, a tiger mural by Hideki Kimura, sunken kotatsu and Scandinavian chairs. Reviewers in 2026 praise attentive counter staff and a sake list mixing famous names with little-known Kyoto brews.

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 host with Swedish guests who had many food allergies chose it as a truly Kyoto place, and the guests were delighted.
A March 2026 couple celebrating on the Go no Tora course fell for the peach sake on the all-you-can-drink list.
A June 2026 counter diner loved the seared hamo and shibazuke potato salad, but had not known smoking was allowed.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋・日本酒バー・日本料理、下京区四条町369 コーポ綾小路、烏丸駅から徒歩3分、毎日 (祝日も) 15:00〜24:00 (L.O.料理23:00、飲み物23:30、焼き物・揚げ物は22時ごろまで)、不定休、予約可 (当日のキャンセルは原則不可)、カード (VISA・Master・JCB・AMEX・Diners)・PayPay 可、電子マネー不可、36席、カウンター・座敷・掘りごたつ、貸切20〜50名、喫煙可、車いす可、Wi-Fi、2014年3月28日開店、紹介文 (英訳): SOU・SOU の大きなのれん、Hideki Kimura の虎の壁画、炭火焼とおばんざい。インボイス登録は株式会社ＡＦＬＯ・ＸＬ (国税庁)。口コミ (2026年3〜10月、英語): おばんざい5種、鶏のたたき、ネックの炭火焼、大きなしいたけ、さんま、鱧の炙り、しば漬けのポテトサラダ、明太子のゆば巻き、オニオンポタージュ、五黄の寅コース、飲み放題の桃のお酒、有名銘柄と京都の地酒、アレルギーの多い客も満足 (2026年6月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Smoking allowed; no same-day cancellations; cards and PayPay.

kyoto_cl_fashion_cafe.gf_detail: Ask. Drinks with macarons, crème brûlée, nougat or parfait (2026 reviews).
kyoto_cl_fashion_cafe.vegan_detail: Ask. Coffee and tea; the desserts have egg or dairy (2026 reviews).
kyoto_cl_fashion_cafe.hours_raw: Mon, Thu–Sun 11:00–18:00; closed Tuesdays and Wednesdays; hours may change (Tabelog). Two sets: a drink, or a drink with dessert (July 2026 review); staff seat guests and take orders at the table (March 2026 review). Cards (AMEX); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Café on the ground floor with racing trophies; the boutique upstairs (March 2026 review). 5 min from Karasuma-Oike (Tabelog).
kyoto_cl_fashion_cafe.notes: [Café · Sakaimachi] The boutique café of JRA jockey Christophe Lemaire: tables numbered like furlong poles, live racing on screen, trophies, saddles and whips to see, and dessert sets with coffee. A must for racing fans; about ¥1,000–3,000.

roles: Brand store of jockey Christophe Lemaire
chef_bio.background: Opened 6 November 2025 (Tabelog) as the boutique and café of JRA jockey Christophe Lemaire (February and March 2026 reviews). Trophies from races abroad, saddles, whips and racing silks on display (2026 reviews).
chef_bio.specialty: Drink and dessert sets; racing exhibits.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 visitor was eating a strawberry sundae when Lemaire walked in, and got a handshake and a photo.
An August 2026 pair arrived at opening, held a jockey's whip for a photo, and sat at the table marked for the 2-furlong pole.
A September 2026 fan, turned away by a queue on the first try, came back and watched the Green Channel racing broadcast over ginger ale and macarons.

kyoto_hikohachi_higashiyama.gf_detail: Ask. Sushi and sashimi are often served with soy sauce; the lunch set includes tempura (April 2026 reviews).
kyoto_hikohachi_higashiyama.vegan_detail: Not vegan: sushi, seafood bowls and grilled fish (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_hikohachi_higashiyama.hours_raw: Lunch 11:45–14:00 (L.O. 13:45); dinner 17:30–22:30 (L.O. 21:30); closed Mondays, but open 31 December and 1 January (Tabelog). Cover ¥300–500 (Tabelog Japanese original 「お通し代300円〜500円」). Cards; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 16 seats: 5 at the counter, 4 at tables, 6 at sunken kotatsu; private rooms; non-smoking (Tabelog). Two-hour all-you-can-drink for ¥2,000 with banquet courses (April 2026 review). 1 min from the Higashiyama Yasui bus stop (Tabelog).
kyoto_hikohachi_higashiyama.notes: [Sushi · Higashiyama Yasui] A traditional-fronted sushi and seafood izakaya between Kiyomizu and Gion: a showy 14-topping seafood bowl set at lunch, sushi, sashimi and tempura by night, with a golf-loving chef at the counter. Reviews are mixed on service.

chef_bio.background: A chef who loves golf and talks about it at the counter (January 2025 review).

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 sightseer, coming from Kiyomizu-dera and Ishibe-koji, was struck by the 14-topping seafood bowl the moment it arrived.
A January 2025 guest at the counter found the hospitality warm and the golf talk with the chef fun.
A January 2026 repeat visitor was put off by a drunk customer and found the business style pushy.

cultural_comfort.note: Counter, tables and private rooms; tourist-friendly lunch.

kyoto_karasuma_curry.gf_detail: Ask. Spice curries with coconut milk (October 2025); whether the roux uses flour is not stated.
kyoto_karasuma_curry.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chicken curry and pork keema only (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_karasuma_curry.hours_raw: Lunch Mon–Sat 11:30–14:30; closed Sundays; Saturdays and holidays are not fixed — check Instagram (Tabelog). At night the space is a live house (2025 reviews). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 22 seats at tables; heated tobacco only in a smoking area (Tabelog). Basement of the Karasuma Daisan Star Building at Karasuma-Takoyakushi, 2 blocks north of Shijo-Karasuma (Tabelog).
kyoto_karasuma_curry.notes: [Curry · Karasuma] A lunch-only curry counter in a basement live house, with a drum kit on stage and rock videos on the screen: chicken curry, pork keema or both for ¥1,200, served by the owner alone.

chef_bio.background: The owner runs the place alone and keeps refilling water (July 2025 review); the room is a live house and bar at night (2025 reviews).

anecdotes.text: A May 2025 visitor walked down to find a stage with a drum set and 20-year-old music videos on the projector.
A July 2026 diner looked up the song on the screen — Journey's "Open Arms" — over a chicken curry.

kyoto_bar_lecoq_fuyacho.gf_detail: Ask. A cocktail, whisky and brandy bar; the only food in reviews is cashew nuts with drinks; check beer and liqueurs (2022–2026 reviews).
kyoto_bar_lecoq_fuyacho.vegan_detail: Ask. Spirits and fresh-fruit cocktails; no ingredient information (2022–2026 reviews).
kyoto_bar_lecoq_fuyacho.hours_raw: Tuesday–Saturday 17:00–01:00; Sunday 15:00–23:00; closed Monday (Tabelog). Cards: JCB, AMEX and Diners (Tabelog; April 2026). Smoking allowed (Tabelog). 8 counter seats and one table for two (March 2025). Groups of up to four; no loud conversation (April 2026). Often full — call ahead (November 2023; April 2026). 5 min on foot from Kyoto-Shiyakusho-mae (April 2023).
kyoto_bar_lecoq_fuyacho.notes: [Bar · Fuyacho-Nijo, cocktails and brandy] A quiet, dimly lit counter bar near Kyoto City Hall, with jazz on analog records, fine glassware, seasonal fresh-fruit cocktails, single malts and an unusually deep brandy shelf. Run by a bartender who trained at Gion’s El Tesoro. Small groups only, no loud talk; often full, so call ahead. Smoking allowed.

chef_bio.background: An April 2023 reviewer names the owner-bartender as Minami, who worked at the Gion bar El Tesoro before opening LeCoq. Reviewers describe a serious manner that warms up in conversation (November 2023; April 2026) and a particular love of cognac and armagnac (April 2026).

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 visitor from Tokyo, alone at the counter on a weekday, was introduced to cognac and given tips on bars to try in Tokyo.
An April 2026 whisky lover worked through five unfamiliar single malts at the owner’s suggestion.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: BAR LeCoq、バー、中京区麩屋町二条下ル尾張町210-3 第二ふじビル 1F、京都市役所前駅から363m、火〜土 17:00〜翌1:00、日 15:00〜23:00、月曜定休、カードはJCB・AMEX・Diners、喫煙可。口コミ (英語): 店主でバーテンダーのMinamiさんは祇園のEl Tesoro出身 (2023年4月)、季節のフルーツカクテル (ぶどう、マスカット、梨、ポンカン、苺)、カウンター8席と2人掛けテーブル1卓 (2025年3月)、レコードのジャズ、コニャックとアルマニャック、4人まで、大声の会話は禁止 (2026年4月)、シングルモルト、カードが使える (2026年4月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Quiet adult bar; groups of up to four; smoking allowed.

kyoto_matsusaka_gyu_whats_muromachi.gf_detail: Ask. Grilled Matsusaka and other wagyu with sauces, yukhoe, meat sushi and namul; sauce ingredients are not stated (own site; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_matsusaka_gyu_whats_muromachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a beef yakiniku restaurant (own site; Tabelog).
kyoto_matsusaka_gyu_whats_muromachi.hours_raw: Daily 17:00–23:00 (last orders 22:00); lunch 11:00–14:00 Monday–Wednesday, sometimes closed; closures possible over New Year (Tabelog; the shop’s FAQ gives dinner hours only). Seats are held for 2 hours (last orders at 90 minutes) (Tabelog; own site). Private rooms for 2–8: à la carte guests pay a 10% room charge, and fully private rooms are for course bookings only (Tabelog, original 室料10％). Cards, IC cards, QR incl. Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). 72 seats incl. tatami and sunken-floor seating around a courtyard with a small pond (Tabelog; own site). Non-smoking (Tabelog). English menu and English-speaking staff (own site; August 2026). 4 min on foot from Karasuma-Oike (Tabelog).
kyoto_matsusaka_gyu_whats_muromachi.notes: [Yakiniku · Muromachi-Sanjo machiya, Matsusaka beef] Matsusaka-beef yakiniku in an 80-year-old townhouse with private rooms around a pond courtyard, aimed squarely at visitors: English menu and staff, cuts explained at the table, platters from ¥7,000. Expensive; à la carte guests pay 10% for a private room. Flagged: one of a small group (株式会社WHAT'S) with a lifestyle shop in Shiga and a deli counter in Osaka.

chef_bio.background: Run by the Kyoto company 株式会社WHAT'S (group site), whose receipts are issued by 有限会社カリス at the same Higashiyama address (NTA invoice register). The shop says it buys whole Matsusaka cattle, and it won awards in the SAVOR JAPAN Best Restaurant Award 2025–2026, including first place nationally for bookings from overseas visitors (own site).

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 host brought a foreign guest, who called it the best Japanese yakiniku ever tasted; staff explained each cut in English.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 松阪牛WHAT'S 京都室町店、烏丸御池駅から徒歩4分、築80年の京町家、松阪牛の一頭買い、小さな池のある中庭、個室・半個室、三大和牛盛り合わせ (神戸牛・近江牛・松阪牛、120g 7,000円〜)、数量限定の松阪牛プレミアム盛り (20種の部位、50,000円)、SAVOR JAPAN Best Restaurant Award 2025-2026で全国予約数ランキング1位など、英語メニューと英語対応スタッフ、17:00〜23:00 (L.O. 22:00)、年末年始など臨時休業あり、席のみ予約は2時間制。グループサイト: 株式会社WHAT'S (東山区三条通白川橋東入ル2丁目五軒町106-20)、京都室町店、滋賀 堅田、阪急うめだ本店。適格請求書: 有限会社カリス (同住所)。食べログ: 72席、個室はアラカルトの場合室料10％、完全個室はコース予約のみ、月〜水は昼 11:00〜14:00 (不定休)、カード・交通系IC・QR (Alipay、WeChat Pay含む)、禁煙。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): ユッケ、肉寿司2種、タン、5種の焼肉、英語で部位を説明。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu and English-speaking staff; 10% room charge on à la carte in private rooms.

existence.note: Own site and Tabelog official listing; reviews dated May 2025 to August 2026.

kyoto_tachinomi_botan_shinmachi.gf_detail: Ask. Fried mackerel, croquettes, kushikatsu, pizza, tonpei-yaki and oden; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_tachinomi_botan_shinmachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork, offal and mackerel dishes, and oden in dashi (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_tachinomi_botan_shinmachi.hours_raw: Tuesday–Sunday 15:00–22:00; closed Monday (Tabelog). 12 places at an L-shaped counter, standing room for 15; folding chairs on hand (Tabelog; March 2025, January and May 2026). Cards, e-money and barcode payment (May 2026). Non-smoking, with a smoking spot outside (Tabelog; May 2026). 5 min on foot from Shijo station (January 2026).
kyoto_tachinomi_botan_shinmachi.notes: [Standing bar · Shinmachi-Bukkoji, from 15:00] A small, spotless L-shaped standing bar near Shijo-Karasuma, open from mid-afternoon: highballs from ¥380, a changing sake list, oden and hearty small plates. Chairs are there if you need one; staff are all women, and regulars chat freely. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: A May 2026 reviewer describes an owner keen on sake and happy to talk about it, and an all-female staff. No operator was found.
chef_bio.specialty: Oden and izakaya small plates; sake.

anecdotes.text: A February 2026 visitor walking from Gojo to Shijo spotted the oden pot over the counter and ordered the oden-broth dashimaki.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 立ちのみ ぼたん、立ち飲み、下京区新町通仏光寺南入岩戸山町421 コタニビル 1F、四条駅から332m、火〜日 15:00〜22:00、月曜定休、カウンター12席、立ち飲み15名、禁煙、電子マネー可。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 折りたたみ椅子あり、万願寺みそ、豚ハラミ炒め、カレーコロッケ、鯖の甘辛揚げ、とん平焼き、ホルモンの酒粕味噌煮、おでん、おでん出汁巻き、特大串カツ400円、マルゲリータ450円、赤しそハイボール380円、角ハイボール380円、店主は日本酒好き、スタッフは全員女性、店外に喫煙所、カード・電子マネー・バーコード決済可。

cultural_comfort.note: Regulars’ standing bar; easy for solo women (May 2026).

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated March 2025 to June 2026.

kyoto_rit_karasuma_oike.gf_detail: Ask. Pasta, house focaccia and pizza; mushroom risotto and salads on the menu; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_rit_karasuma_oike.vegan_detail: Ask. A daily oil-based pasta (such as peperoncino) and salads may suit, but nothing is described as vegan; the dressing has cheese (2026 reviews).
kyoto_rit_karasuma_oike.hours_raw: Monday–Wednesday and Friday–Sunday: lunch 11:30–15:00 (last orders 14:00), dinner 17:30–23:00 (last orders 22:00); closed Thursday (Tabelog). Opened 21 August 2025 (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). A counter facing the kitchen and four tables for two at the back (September 2026). Non-smoking; children welcome (Tabelog). Busy some nights — call ahead (September 2026). 5 min on foot from Karasuma-Oike (Tabelog).
kyoto_rit_karasuma_oike.notes: [Italian · Karasuma-Oike, opened 2025] A small, friendly Italian near Karasuma-Oike with a counter facing a spotless kitchen: ¥1,500 pasta lunches with salad and house focaccia, tiramisu, and at night antipasti, risotto and pasta, many in solo-sized portions. Closed Thursday.

chef_bio.background: A December 2025 reviewer learned that the chef trained in hotels and restaurants rather than at cooking school. Reviewers describe a friendly owner who chats with guests (August and September 2026). No operator was found.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 solo diner was told the two-person antipasti platter was fine for one, and heard a regular declare it the best Italian in the area.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: rit...、イタリアン、中京区左京町、烏丸御池駅から徒歩5分、月〜水・金〜日 11:30〜15:00 (L.O. 14:00)・17:30〜23:00 (L.O. 22:00)、木曜定休、2025年8月21日オープン、カード・電子マネー・QR可、禁煙、子供可。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): ホテルやレストランで修業、パスタランチ1,500円 (サラダ、日替わりパスタ2〜3種、自家製フォカッチャ)、スイーツセット2,100円 (ティラミスとドリンク)、前菜の盛り合わせ、イカスミのスパゲッティ、キノコのリゾット、グラスワイン700円から、量の調整可、ディナーコース (前菜、アヒージョ、サラダ、ピザ、パスタ)。

kyoto_yashima_udon_higashiyama.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat udon, soba and tempura (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_yashima_udon_higashiyama.vegan_detail: Not vegan: noodles in dashi broth; egg, chicken and shrimp-tempura bowls (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_yashima_udon_higashiyama.hours_raw: Monday–Saturday 11:30–13:30; closed Sunday (Tabelog). Lines form at lunch; quick turnover (May and December 2025). Cash only: no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). About six or seven counter seats; return your tray to the counter when done (Tabelog; May and September 2026). Takeaway (Tabelog; November 2026). 55 m from Higashiyama station (Tabelog).
kyoto_yashima_udon_higashiyama.notes: [Udon and soba · Higashiyama-Sanjo, couple-run] A tiny, old-fashioned counter by Higashiyama station where an older couple turns out Kyoto-style udon and soba in light dashi, with mini rice-bowl sets, at prices well under ¥1,000. Lunch only, Monday to Saturday; cash only; expect a short queue.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe the shop as run by a couple, efficient and polite under pressure (February and May 2025), and as an elderly couple who struggle when customers arrive all at once (September 2026). A May 2026 visitor saw a man and a woman working. No founding date or other shop was found.
chef_bio.specialty: Kyoto-style udon and soba with mini donburi.

anecdotes.text: A May 2025 group, turned away by full soba and Chinese restaurants after Heian Shrine, found an oyakodon set here just before a queue formed outside.
